tiers.focus: Hanoi, Haiphong, and the Red River
tiers.learning_objective: Students learn that geography is dialectical — north and south are not opposites but complements.
tiers.witness_requirement: Each port requires a northern and southern witness

tiers.focus: Da Nang, Ho Chi Minh City, Can Tho
tiers.learning_objective: Students learn that trade routes BIND the country — north-south, central-south, river-sea.
tiers.witness_requirement: Each contract requires a yin and yang witness

tiers.learning_objective: Students learn that the law of the sea is the substrate's peace — every dispute resolved by witnesses.
tiers.witness_requirement: Each dispute requires witnesses from both regions
